hints: In right-angled triangle $OBC$, the hypotenuse is $OB = 15$ and the adjacent side to $\angle BOC$ is $OC = 10$.
Evaluate in radians to 4 decimal places.
walkthrough:
Use right-angled triangle $OBC$ where $\angle OCB = \frac{\pi}{2}$, $OB = 15\text{ cm}$, and $OC = 10\text{ cm}$:
$$\cos(\angle BOC) = \frac{OC}{OB} = \frac{10}{15} = \frac{2}{3} \implies \angle BOC = \arccos\left(\frac{2}{3}\right)$$

Since $OA \perp OD$ and $OC \perp BC$, express $\theta = \angle AOB$ as the complement of $\angle BOC$:
$$\theta = \frac{\pi}{2} - \arccos\left(\frac{2}{3}\right) = \arcsin\left(\frac{2}{3}\right)$$

Evaluate in radians to 4 decimal places:
$$\theta = \arcsin(0.6666667...) \approx 0.729727... \approx 0.7297 \text{ radians}$$

hints: Calculate arc lengths: arc $AB = 15(0.7297)$ and arc $CD = 10(\frac{\pi}{2}) = 5\pi$.
Sum all boundary components: $BC + \text{arc } AB + AD + \text{arc } CD$, where $AD = OA + OD = 15 + 10 = 25$.
Calculate the area by summing: triangle $OBC$, sector $AOB$, and quarter circle sector $COD$.
walkthrough:
Find the length of side $BC$ using Pythagoras' theorem in $\triangle OBC$:
$$BC = \sqrt{OB^2 - OC^2} = \sqrt{15^2 - 10^2} = \sqrt{225 - 100} = \sqrt{125} = 5\sqrt{5} \approx 11.1803\text{ cm}$$

Calculate the lengths of the two curved circular arcs:
$$\text{Arc } AB = r_1 \theta = 15 \times 0.729728... \approx 10.9459\text{ cm}$$
$$\text{Arc } CD = r_2 \left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right) = 10 \times \frac{\pi}{2} = 5\pi \approx 15.7080\text{ cm}$$

Calculate the total perimeter of the shaded region:
$$\text{Perimeter} = BC + \text{Arc } AB + (OA + OD) + \text{Arc } CD$$
$$\text{Perimeter} = 11.1803 + 10.9459 + (15 + 10) + 15.7080 = 62.8342... \approx 62.8\text{ cm}$$

Calculate the total area by summing the three composite regions:
$$\text{Area}(\triangle OBC) = \frac{1}{2} \times OC \times BC = \frac{1}{2} \times 10 \times 5\sqrt{5} = 25\sqrt{5} \approx 55.9017\text{ cm}^2$$
$$\text{Area}(\text{Sector } AOB) = \frac{1}{2} r_1^2 \theta = \frac{1}{2}(15^2)(0.729728...) = 112.5 \times 0.729728... \approx 82.0944\text{ cm}^2$$
$$\text{Area}(\text{Sector } COD) = \frac{1}{2} r_2^2 \left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right) = \frac{1}{2}(10^2)\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right) = 25\pi \approx 78.5398\text{ cm}^2$$

Sum the three component areas:
$$\text{Total Area} = 55.9017 + 82.0944 + 78.5398 = 216.5359... \approx 217\text{ cm}^2$$
